transcript: Speaker 1 @0.0s [en]: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining the weekly planning meeting for the mobile app redesign.
Speaker 2 @7.0s [en]: Morning.
Speaker 2 @8.2s [en]: I reviewed the design files yesterday and I have a few concerns about the onboarding flow.
Speaker 1 @14.2s [en]: Okay, let's start there.
Speaker 1 @16.5s [en]: What is the main problem you noticed?
Speaker 2 @19.8s [en]: The sign up screen asks for too much information up front.
Speaker 2 @23.9s [en]: Most people will abandon it before they finish.
Speaker 1 @27.7s [en]: That makes sense.
Speaker 1 @29.3s [en]: Could we move the profile questions to a later step after the first login?
Speaker 2 @35.1s [en]: Yes, I think that would work.
Speaker 2 @38.0s [en]: We would only ask for an email address and a password at the beginning.
Speaker 1 @43.0s [en]: Great.
Speaker 1 @44.1s [en]: Then let's decide that the sign up screen will only collect email and password.
Speaker 2 @49.7s [en]: Agreed.
Speaker 2 @50.9s [en]: I will update the wire frames and share them with the team before Thursday.
Speaker 1 @56.1s [en]: Perfect.
Speaker 1 @57.4s [en]: The next topic is the notification settings.
Speaker 1 @60.5s [en]: Customers keep asking for a quiet mode during the weekend.
Speaker 2 @65.2s [en]: We could add a simple toggle in the settings page.
Speaker 2 @65.2s [en]: It should be easy to build.
Speaker 1 @65.2s [en]: I like that idea, but we need to check with the backend team about scheduling.
Speaker 2 @65.2s [en]: I can talk to Omar about it this afternoon and I will report back tomorrow.
Speaker 1 @65.2s [en]: Thank you.
Speaker 1 @65.2s [en]: Another item is the performance of the dashboard.
Speaker 1 @90.0s [en]: It still takes several seconds to load on older phones.
Speaker 2 @95.2s [en]: I measured it last week.
Speaker 2 @97.2s [en]: Most of the delay comes from loading every chart at the same time.
Speaker 1 @101.9s [en]: So should we load the charts only when the user scrolls to them?
Speaker 2 @106.7s [en]: Exactly.
Speaker 2 @108.1s [en]: Lazy loading should cut the waiting time roughly in half.
Speaker 1 @112.5s [en]: All right.
Speaker 1 @113.7s [en]: Let's make lazy loading the priority for the next sprint.
Speaker 2 @118.2s [en]: Sounds good.
Speaker 2 @119.8s [en]: Should we also invite the support team to the next review?
Speaker 1 @124.3s [en]: Yes, please send them an invitation.
Speaker 1 @127.1s [en]: Their feedback about customer complaints would be really helpful.
Speaker 2 @131.7s [en]: Will do.
Speaker 2 @133.0s [en]: Is there anything else we need to cover today?
Speaker 1 @136.8s [en]: I think that is everything.
Speaker 1 @138.6s [en]: Thanks everyone, and see you next week.
